title: Robust maximum hands-off optimal control: existence, maximum principle, and $L^{0}$-$L^1$ equivalence
summary: This work advances the maximum hands-off sparse control framework by developing a robust counterpart for constrained linear systems with parametric uncertainties. The resulting optimal control problem minimizes an $L^{0}$ objective subject to an uncountable, compact family of constraints, and is therefore a nonconvex, nonsmooth robust optimization problem.
